sources.title: Martin Costabel, Boundary Integral Operators on Lipschitz Domains: Elementary Results, SIAM Journal on Mathematical Analysis 19(3) (1988), 613–626
sources.locator: Complete article, printed pp. 613–626; specifically §§2–5, including the trace/extension arguments, layer maps and jumps, energy/Gårding estimates, Galerkin result, and two-dimensional capacity caveat.
sources.reading_evidence: The complete author-hosted scanned article was downloaded as an 8-sheet PDF. Every scan containing printed pp. 613–626 was rendered and visually inspected, including the complete local reasoning rather than only the abstract or theorem statements. The local carriers supply their own proofs; this source was used to audit scope and conventions.

contents.name: Normalized fundamental solution and simple/double layer kernels (Section 2, equations (2.5)–(2.7))
contents.support: The local kernel definition fixes the 1/(4πr) normalization and a separate local annulus proof establishes its distributional fundamental-solution identity.

contents.name: Lipschitz trace spaces, graph charts, and continuous trace/lifting results
contents.locator: §2 and the proof of Lemma 3.6, printed pp. 614–616 and 619–620
contents.support: The local trace proof is built from the flat Fourier estimate, chart flattening, reflection, and finite patching; it does not widen a published C1 trace theorem.

contents.name: Weak single-layer mapping, conormal spaces, and transmission jump
contents.support: The local theorem defines the energy solution variationally and proves boundedness, positivity/coercivity, the conormal jump, and the smooth face-supported kernel identification.

contents.name: Weak double-layer jumps, common conormal, and transmission energy identity
contents.locator: Lemma 4.1 and the proof of Theorem 2, printed pp. 620–622
contents.support: The local proof derives the weak jump and common-conormal statements from the affine transmission minimizer; its separate remark records the unresolved edge extension.

contents.name: Hypersingular Gårding/ellipticity estimate modulo constants
contents.support: The local energy identity and trace/Poincare estimates give quotient coercivity and the rank-one constant-mode stabilization.

contents.name: Galerkin stability and quasi-optimality for the coercive boundary form
contents.support: The local conforming P0 proof consumes the actual published second Strang interface with zero consistency defect.

contents.name: The two-dimensional capacity-one exception to coercivity/invertibility
contents.reason: The assigned 2D branch is limited to the logarithmic capacity convention and its homothety scaling; no 2D coercivity or invertibility theorem is stated or silently inferred from the 3D energy proof.

sources.title: Francisco-Javier Sayas, First Steps in the Boundary Element Method (2015 lecture notes)
sources.locator: Complete 51-page PDF downloaded; relevant full sections read: Chapter 1 §§1.2–1.6 and Chapter 2 §§2.1–2.5 (PDF pp. 3–41), including the kernel conventions, P0 discretization, logarithmic scaling, polyhedral charts, Helmholtz layers, jumps, and weak transmission formulation.
sources.reading_evidence: The complete 51-page full-text PDF was downloaded and converted locally; the complete reasoning in the relevant Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 sections was inspected. The pair adopts only explicit hypotheses and signs and supplies full local proofs for the claims used.

contents.name: Three-dimensional Laplace single layer and sphere normalization
contents.support: The example evaluates the integral directly and independently checks the 4π kernel normalization and outward-normal jump.

contents.name: Surface partition and conforming piecewise-constant P0 space
contents.support: The local definition fixes a conforming triangular surface family and places P0 functions in H^{-1/2}.

contents.name: P0 Galerkin single-layer equation and energy estimate
contents.support: The local proof establishes exact conforming Galerkin well-posedness and applies the actual second Strang supplier.

contents.name: Logarithmic kernel, capacity, and scale-dependent constant mode
contents.support: The local proof derives both the logarithmic energy capacity law and the rank-one layer scaling term by pushforward and change of variables.

contents.name: Lipschitz graph charts, polyhedral boundaries, and almost-everywhere normal
contents.support: The page definition states the chart, connected exterior, polyhedral subclass, orientation, and trace-space conventions explicitly.

contents.name: Signed Laplace double-layer jumps and weak transmission formulation
contents.support: The local proof computes the planar sign and derives the weak conormal equality through the variational transmission class.

contents.name: Helmholtz single/double layer kernels and combined-field boundary definition
contents.support: Only the smooth-boundary kernels and combined-field operator definition are taken from this source; the conditional invertibility hypotheses are recorded separately and remain unresolved.

contents.name: Difficulty of coincident/adjacent panel-pair quadrature
contents.locator: Chapter 1 §1.3 and the singular quadrature discussion in the full notes
contents.support: The algorithm requires an explicit per-pair transformed-integral certificate and returns uncertified when an arbitrary self/edge-adjacent pair lacks one.
